verdict.rationale: Granola documents an official MCP server ('Granola MCP') for connecting AI tools/agents to meeting notes (search, list_meetings, get_meeting_transcript, query_granola_meetings), and a runtime probe confirms the hosted endpoint https://mcp.granola.ai/mcp is live and correctly speaks MCP's OAuth-protected resource flow. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of a successful agent connection beyond the vendor docs and probe.
